candidates.name: wink-peak-v1
candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent PNG animation keyframe for the same illustrated desktop kitten.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Keep the identical canvas composition, low resting pose, head angle, fur colors, outline style, ears, strawberry, cream, cone, paws and tail. Change ONLY the eyelids inside the two existing eye regions. Preserve the little original nose and original tiny mouth exactly; do not add a smile or change the mouth.
Primary request: a gentle, natural single-eye blink at its held closed pose. The eye on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE is completely closed, with a relaxed near-horizontal eyelid line, a very shallow soft downward curve like a calm natural slow blink. Preserve the eye's overall width and location. Do NOT make an inverted-U arch or caret-shaped cartoon smile-eye, do not squeeze the corner upward.
The eye on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE remains open but responds softly: its upper eyelid lowers only about 10–15 percent compared with the source. Keep this eye bright and gentle, keep the original round pupil/iris size and gaze direction, naturally occluding its top with the eyelid rather than shrinking or moving the pupil. The result should look like a friendly quiet wink, not an enormous frozen stare and not a drowsy half-closed eye.
No eyebrows, wrinkles, extra lashes, cheek creases, tongue, teeth, new mouth, new props, head movement or body movement. No added text, contact sheet or multiple poses. One kitten, one complete pose. Preserve transparent background and clean antialiased edges. Match the original framing and scale exactly.
candidates.visualReview: Closed eye is shallow and calmer than old arched expression; right eye responds, but generated extra eyebrow above it, violating constraints. Rejected pending targeted correction.

candidates.name: wink-peak-v2
candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target, the same desktop kitten's wink pose. Make only two very small cleanup corrections to the eyes: (1) Completely remove the extra dark eyebrow/crease hovering immediately above the OPEN eye on the right side of the image, filling it seamlessly with the existing gray fur. There must be only ONE upper eyelid boundary contiguous with that eye, with plain gray fur above it; no separate eyebrow line. Keep that open eye at this gently relaxed aperture and keep its iris, pupil and highlights unchanged. (2) Make the CLOSED eye on the left side a clean, thin, shallow, relaxed eyelid line: remove the little upturned lash hooks at its outer end, reduce its heavy stroke to match the original kitten's line art, and retain a mild smooth shallow curve rather than a high arch. Preserve the same eye endpoints/position.
Keep the original tiny mouth, nose, forehead marking and cheeks exactly unchanged. Keep the complete character, head angle, ears, decorations, paws, tail, colors, shading, outline, size and placement identical. One complete pose on real transparent background. No new eyebrows, lashes, creases, expression lines or details.
candidates.visualReview: Removed unintended right eyebrow. Closed eye is shallow with friendly relaxed line; open eye has gently softened upper edge. Candidate suitable for registered-face review, not yet approved as complete animation. Model changed composition/scale and tiny mouth; root must register eye-only art on exact original body/mouth.

candidates.name: wink-peak-v3
candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the registered wink pose. Input image 2 is only an exact positioning, original eye-size and identity reference. Produce one corrected full-body wink pose, on a transparent background, matching image 1's exact canvas placement, body scale, head angle and pixel proportions. Do not zoom or crop.
Change only the eyes. The open eye on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE is currently too big. Restore its original width and center from reference image 2, then give it a gentle accompanying squint: eyelid opening about 75–80 percent of the ORIGINAL eye height in image 2. Lower the curved upper eyelid a little and lift the lower eyelid a little, forming a soft rounded almond opening; retain a warm bright expression. The eyelids naturally occlude the original-sized round black pupil and cyan iris. Keep their original gaze and proportional size; do not shrink the entire eyeball or grow/shift it. No straight horizontal tired lid and no eyebrow/crease above it.
The left-side eye remains fully closed as in image 1, with a single thin, very shallow and smooth eyelid line at the same location and face tilt. Remove its hooked upturned outer tip; use softly tapered ends, no eyelash hook, no high arch.
Keep the small original nose, mouth, white muzzle/forehead marking and pink cheeks unchanged. All fur, ears, strawberry, cream, cone, paws and tail remain exactly unchanged. Never add eyebrows, lashes, wrinkle lines, tongue, teeth, new mouth, cheek lines, text or props. Only one kitten and one pose. Transparent background. Preserve original framing and scale.
candidates.visualReview: Right eye opening now approximately 75% original height, responds visibly while remaining rounded and bright. Left lid is shallow; tiny tapered outer lift remains but no high arch. Composition closer to original. Requires registered-eye-only and animated review.

candidates.name: wink-half-v1
candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: one in-between keyframe in a gentle single-eye blink animation.
Input image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET: the kitten's original open-eyed idle pose. Input image 2 is the END-POSE REFERENCE only: a left-eye wink with a softly responding right eye. Create the halfway eyelid position between the two images while preserving image 1's exact original framing, scale, head angle, eye locations and body. Do not zoom, crop or move any part of the kitten.
On the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE, make the eye about halfway closed: the upper eyelid has softly descended and the lower eyelid has gently lifted, leaving a smooth rounded almond-shaped eye opening about HALF the original vertical height. The original black pupil and cyan iris remain naturally visible through this aperture, with the original pupil's size and gaze; they are occluded by eyelids, not shrunk, flattened or moved. Keep the upper lid gently curved, not a straight tired/angry line. This is a friendly transitional blink, not an eye roll or sultry expression.
On the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE, perform only HALF of the small response seen in image 2: retain about 88–90% of the original eye's vertical opening, with a subtly relaxed upper eyelid and barely lifted lower eyelid. Keep this eye at its original width and location and preserve its original round pupil and iris.
No eyebrows, wrinkle lines, extra eyelashes, hooks or high-arched closed-eye lines. The nose, tiny original mouth, forehead marking, cheeks, fur, ears, strawberry, cream, cone, paws and tail remain unchanged from image 1. One complete kitten pose, real transparent background, no text or extra props.
candidates.visualReview: Left eye about half open with curved eyelids and visible original-position pupil; right eye mostly open. Gray diagonal wrinkle above inner left eyelid needs removal. Source nose approximately (570,820)/1280, so normalized translation to original nose must be applied before judging eye placement.
